ProtocolVersion.name: AgenticDriver-Version
ProtocolVersion.description: Exact wire version to select. Unsupported values fail before provider/tool execution. Independent of package versions.

OptionalEvents.name: AgenticDriver-Accept-Optional-Events
OptionalEvents.description: Opt in to unknown advisory event types marked optional:true. Older clients omit this header and receive only the original event types.

JobEventPage.description: Contiguous committed events after the requested cursor, bounded to 100 events and approximately 1.5 MB per page. No automatic tool dispatch or retry.

apiEquivalentCostUsd.description: Reported API-equivalent estimate; never subscription spend or an invoice charge.

Usage.description: Measurements are omitted when unknown. Cached input is a subset of input tokens. Totals are omitted if any model step lacks that measurement.

outcome.description: Effects may have occurred; reconcile them before any replacement operation.

ErrorInfo.description: Stable code, displayable message and retryability hint. Clients preserve unknown codes; retryable never authorizes automatic replay of tool effects.

optional.description: An unknown type may be skipped only when optional is explicitly true; its envelope and sequence must still be validated.

oneOf.description: Advisory extension. Hosts send new event types only to clients that explicitly accept optional events. They cannot carry required state transitions or actions.
